description: Creates an invoice for one bundle (500 passes, $3 quoted in the chosen asset). Returns {invoiceId, payTo, amount (base units), human, chainId, expires}. Pay from any wallet; then blind tokens locally with the SDK and call robyn_plus_claim. For btc pass refundAddress (your BTC address) — the invoice returns a Chainflip deposit address.
name: robyn_plus_invoice
title: Plus — create an invoice
